title: With default fonts and certain specific panel thicknesses, the time display bounces a bit when any digits display a 4
line: On a vertical panel, the Digital Clock's time no longer shrinks for a second whenever it ends in a 4.
explanation: On vertical panels the clock's time label used Text.Fit, which fits the font to both the label's height and the panel's width using the live text. A trailing 4 extends a little further to the right than other digits in Noto Sans, so in that second the text no longer fit the width and Qt picked a font one pixel smaller, then grew it back the next second. The label now uses Text.VerticalFit: its height already comes from sizehelper, which is sized from the widest possible time string, so the font size no longer depends on which digits are shown.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: keep the time size stable on vertical panels

On vertical panels the time label fitted its live text to the panel's
width, so a 4 as the last digit made the font a pixel smaller for that
second. Fit it only to the height computed from the widest time instead.

BUG: 509556

From 8ee234fbf34c5490d0240b3c4ab52a9154c6f188 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: keep the time size stable on vertical
 panels

On vertical panels the time label fitted its live text to the panel's
width, so a 4 as the last digit made the font a pixel smaller for that
second. Fit it only to the height computed from the widest time instead.

BUG: 509556
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..0d4b38b55c 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -266,7 +266,7 @@ MouseArea {
                 timeLabel.height: sizehelper.contentHeight
                 timeLabel.width: main.width
                 timeLabel.font.pixelSize: Math.min(timeLabel.height, fontHelper.font.pixelSize)
-                timeLabel.fontSizeMode: Text.Fit
+                timeLabel.fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
 
                 timeZoneLabel.height: Math.max(0.7 * timeLabel.height, dateLabel.minimumPixelSize)
                 timeZoneLabel.width: main.width
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, 60 px left panel, 24h with seconds: :04 and :14 are drawn smaller than :03, :05 and :15
Fixed: :04 and :54 are the same size as their neighbours

review.text: Fixes the exact root cause of the vertical-panel clock bounce by switching timeLabel.fontSizeMode from Text.Fit to Text.VerticalFit, matching the oneLineDate state. Because sizehelper already computes the height that fits the widest time string into main.width, fitting only vertically prevents trailing-4 glyph overhang from shrinking the font for a single second. Before/after screenshots and multi-width/12h verification confirm the fix with no regressions.

reviews.text: Fixes the exact root cause of the vertical-panel clock bounce by switching timeLabel.fontSizeMode from Text.Fit to Text.VerticalFit, matching the oneLineDate state. Because sizehelper already computes the height that fits the widest time string into main.width, fitting only vertically prevents trailing-4 glyph overhang from shrinking the font for a single second. Before/after screenshots and multi-width/12h verification confirm the fix with no regressions.

Switching the vertical-panel timeLabel from Text.Fit to Text.VerticalFit is the right minimal fix: sizehelper already fits the widest-digit time string to the panel width, so the font no longer depends on the live digits, and the before/after strips clearly show :04/:14/:54 no longer shrinking. The horizontal 40 px case was already fixed by ffe832ee60. However, Nate marked 519039 as a duplicate of this bug, and it reports a different surface: in the hover tooltip the 4 pushes the second line sideways (6.6.4, after the sizehelper and tnum fixes). That case was not tested with a 24h clock ending in 4 and is not touched by the patch, so BUG: 509556 would close it unverified.
changes: Test the duplicate 519039 case on master (hover tooltip, 24h, seconds shown, across :x4); if the second line still shifts, fix it too (e.g. stable width for the tooltip's time line), otherwise record in verify that it no longer reproduces
